The kernel revealed the real shape: calls are stored under a `"calls"` vector as `{"key" … "model" … "tokens" …}`, and a zero-token call must be rejected. Let me redo it.

(defn usage [key]
  (reduce (fn [acc c]
            (if (= (get c "key") key)
              (+ acc (get c "tokens" 0))
              acc))
          0
          (get (state) "calls" [])))

(defn record_usage [key model tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (not (blank? key)))
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? model) (not (blank? model)))
    (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? tokens) (pos? tokens))
    (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive number" {})))
  (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj [])
               {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
  (usage key))

Rate limits: set_quota(key, tokens) caps a key's total tokens and returns the quota; it throws if the key has already used more. record_usage must throw if the call would take the key over its quota. Keys without a quota are unlimited.

(defn token_quota [key]
  (get (get (state) "quotas" {}) key))

(defn set_quota [key tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (not (blank? key)))
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? tokens) (not (neg? tokens)))
    (throw (ex-info "quota must be a non-negative number" {})))
  (when (> (usage key) tokens)
    (throw (ex-info "quota is below tokens already used" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["quotas" key] tokens)
  tokens)

(defn record_usage [key model tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (not (blank? key)))
    (throw (ex-info "key must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? model) (not (blank? model)))
    (throw (ex-info "model must be a non-empty string" {})))
  (when-not (and (number? tokens) (pos? tokens))
    (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive number" {})))
  (when-some [q (token_quota key)]
    (when (> (+ (usage key) tokens) q)
      (throw (ex-info "quota exceeded" {}))))
  (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj [])
               {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
  (usage key))
